data.name: Ansarul
data.gender_notes: Ansarul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansarul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ansar' which means 'lion'. The suffix 'ul' denotes 'protector' or 'ruler'. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership. It is a powerful and protective name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition. The name Ansarul carries the meaning “Lion-protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansarul usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ansarul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion-protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansarul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
